notes: Pinned interfaces beyond the PRD text: app.routers.terminal.OUT_Q_MAX_BYTES (module int, read at call time); app.herdr.server_alive(timeout) -> bool (any newline-terminated JSON reply = alive); settings.probe_timeout; terminal._spawn(session, rows, cols) -> (pid, fd) forks unconditionally (the binary check lives in the route); terminal.reset_live_count() zeroes the live-terminal counter (tests only).

Backend checks run in the repo-local venv backend/.venv-test (gitignored): create it once, outside the network namespace, with `backend/tests/make_test_venv.sh` (requirements.txt constrained to the deployed freeze + pinned test tools).
composer.ts exports DUP_WINDOW_MS (1500); replacements are grapheme-prefix-minimal (PRD 4.1).
Builders must keep the wrapped-URL link provider (src/wrapLinks.ts, wired in useHerdrTerminal.ts by 3e78f69).

Skeleton change: socketPolicy.onClose(code, reason, everOpened, failStreak) + export NEVER_OPENED_LIMIT (a pure function cannot count 'N closes without opening'). A refusal message contains the server's close reason.

Page facts pinned by the e2e: modifier indicator `.mod-ind` (visible while armed); toasts `.toast` / `.toast.bad`; the connection message is visible page text; Mic button `button.mic-btn`, delivery via POST /api/panes/<id>/send-text then /send-keys.
C-14's tray Enter/^C textarea clear is verified by the C-15 e2e scenario `tray-clear`.
e2e items (network: true) need HW_BUILD_ENV pointing at an env file (outside the repo) with the BUILD_* variables.
